name: 21401 · Annapolis, MD
findings: ZIP 21401 (Annapolis) has 408 nonprofit organizations. 202 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 176 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21401 (Annapolis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21401 (Annapolis) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 176 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
